evidence_table.venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
evidence_table.quote: We report single-step retrosynthesis top-1 accuracy of 52.3% on USPTO-50k using a message passing graph neural network with reaction centre classification.

evidence_table.title: Template-free retrosynthesis via graph attention
evidence_table.quote: Template-free single-step retrosynthesis reaches 48.1% top-1 accuracy on USPTO-50k;

evidence_table.title: Low-data retrosynthesis: how much training data do we need

evidence_table.quote: We reproduce the message passing model on USPTO-50k and obtain single-step top-1 accuracy of 49.0%, lower than the originally reported value, which suggests evaluation leakage.

evidence_table.title: Multi-step route planning with learned heuristics
evidence_table.quote: Multi-step route planning is evaluated by route success rate rather than top-1 single-step accuracy, so results are not directly comparable across the two settings.
